envelope.description: Project managed update state through daemon IPC

body.title: Project managed update state through daemon IPC
body.summary: Publish optional update IDs in managed acknowledgements and outcomes. Use a shared request-time installed-commit projection for threaded and non-threaded status. Preserve the existing fields and unmanaged behavior.
acceptanceChecks: The candidate commit remains hidden from old clients until durable success
A matching terminal outcome and status report the committed or restored release consistently

tests.name: Daemon-initiated update survives supervisor unload and writes one terminal result across a protocol version change
Observe in-flight status throughout injected rollback, then exactly one terminal outcome after restored readiness or a durable operator-recovery decision
Hold application RPCs and indexing until matching durable success across threaded and non-threaded status paths
Managed update helper waits for acknowledgement write before destructive work
Threaded and non-threaded status publish the same committed release for the matching outcome
